rules.statement: The IP has no software-visible register and no CSR workbook; no CSR is exposed by the IP.

rules.condition: When overflow or underflow is flagged
rules.statement: Overflow and underflow indications are 1-cycle pulses, with no sticky status register retaining them.

rules.condition: Software reset sequence, if the producer should not lose words
rules.statement: The owner of the i_rst_n_sw control register stops the producer before the reset if the producer should not lose words.
The owner of the control register drives i_rst_n_sw to 0 for at least one write-clock cycle; it may be held longer.
The owner of the control register drives i_rst_n_sw back to 1 after the reset has started.
The FIFO is usable again on both sides when o_sw_rst_busy is 0 and i_rst_n_sw is 1.
The read side is always released before the write side.
o_sw_rst_busy falls when the write side is released.

Software must not use o_sw_rst_busy = 0 alone as the usable indication while i_rst_n_sw is held at 0, since it is 0 for one write-clock cycle after i_rst_n_sw falls and between sequences while writes are blocked.
The words in the FIFO at the reset are lost.
